tools.name: hoato_ping
tools.description: Show the association this key belongs to, whether it is a live or test key, and its scopes. Write tools need write: true. Call this first. Uses GET /ping.

tools.name: hoato_list_units
tools.description: List every unit in the association, ordered by unit number. Uses GET /units.

tools.name: hoato_get_unit
tools.description: Fetch one unit by id, with its current owners and residents. Uses GET /units/{id}.

tools.name: hoato_create_unit
tools.description: Add a unit to the association. unitNumber must be unique; a duplicate returns 409. Needs a write key. Uses POST /units.

tools.name: hoato_update_unit
tools.description: Change the fields you send on one unit. Omitted fields stay as they are. Needs a write key. Uses PATCH /units/{id}.

tools.name: hoato_list_owners
tools.description: List owners and residents, optionally for one unit. Past owners appear only when includeEnded is true. Uses GET /owners.

tools.name: hoato_add_owner
tools.description: Attach an owner, co-owner, tenant, occupant or property manager to a unit, matched by email. Needs a write key. Uses POST /owners.

tools.name: hoato_update_owner
tools.description: Change the relation, primary flag or notes of one ownership, or end it with endDate and endReason. Ending an ownership removes it from current owners. Needs a write key. Uses PATCH /owners/{id}.

tools.name: hoato_list_requests
tools.description: List maintenance and architectural review (ARC) requests. Filter by kind, status, unit or open (not finished). This list pages by limit only; it has no cursor. Uses GET /requests.

tools.name: hoato_get_request
tools.description: Fetch one maintenance or ARC request by id. Uses GET /requests/{id}.

tools.name: hoato_create_request
tools.description: Open a maintenance request, or an ARC request (which needs unit and description). Defaults: NEW for maintenance, SUBMITTED for ARC. Needs a write key. Uses POST /requests.

tools.name: hoato_update_request
tools.description: Change the fields you send on one request, such as status, priority, schedule, cost or decision note. Omitted fields stay as they are. Needs a write key. Uses PATCH /requests/{id}.

tools.name: hoato_list_charges
tools.description: List assessments and other charges. status "open" covers OPEN and PARTIAL charges. Uses GET /charges.

tools.name: hoato_list_payments
tools.description: List payments recorded for the association, newest first. Uses GET /payments.

tools.name: hoato_record_payment
tools.description: Record a payment that was already collected elsewhere, for example by check or bank transfer. It applies to the unit's open charges, oldest first. It does NOT charge a card or move money. Needs a write key. Uses POST /payments.

tools.name: hoato_get_ledger
tools.description: Get every charge and payment for one unit as a dated ledger with a running balance and the outstanding total. Charges are debits, payments are credits. Uses GET /ledger/{unit}.

tools.name: hoato_list_violations
tools.description: List open and past violations, newest first. Uses GET /violations.

tools.name: hoato_file_violation
tools.description: Record a violation against a unit, with photo URLs. It records the violation only: it sends no notice and sets no fine. A person decides the next step in HOA.to. Needs a write key. Uses POST /violations.

tools.name: hoato_list_documents
tools.description: List published association documents, optionally in one category. Uses GET /documents.

tools.name: hoato_publish_document
tools.description: Publish a document that is already hosted at a URL, and set who can see it with visibility. Owners with that access can see it at once. Needs a write key. Uses POST /documents.

tools.name: hoato_list_meetings
tools.description: List board, annual, special and committee meetings with their minutes. upcoming true returns future meetings, oldest first. Uses GET /meetings.

tools.name: hoato_get_meeting
tools.description: Fetch one meeting by id, with its agenda and minutes. Uses GET /meetings/{id}.

tools.name: hoato_schedule_meeting
tools.description: Schedule a meeting with an agenda and an optional quorum. Needs a write key. Uses POST /meetings.

tools.name: hoato_list_announcements
tools.description: List published announcements to owners, newest first. Uses GET /announcements.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hoato_list_requests, hoato_create_request, hoato_record_payment · Private data: hoato_record_payment, hoato_file_violation, hoato_list_documents, hoato_publish_document · Public sink: hoato_create_unit, hoato_update_unit, hoato_add_owner, hoato_create_request, hoato_update_request, hoato_record_payment, hoato_file_violation, hoato_publish_document, hoato_schedule_meeting.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hoato_list_requests, hoato_create_request, hoato_record_payment · Private data: hoato_record_payment, hoato_file_violation, hoato_list_documents, hoato_publish_document · Public sink: hoato_create_unit, hoato_update_unit, hoato_add_owner, hoato_create_request, hoato_update_request, hoato_record_payment, hoato_file_violation, hoato_publish_document, hoato_schedule_meeting

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
